title: Zara’s Floral & Fruity Hannah Montana Perfume Grants ‘The Best of Both Worlds’ for Under $25
summary: In one of Zara's most nostalgic beauty drops yet, the retailer has bottled Hannah Montana's vibrant spirit with notes of red fruits, rose and vanilla.
contentText:

Nobody’s perfect, but Zara’s new Hannah Montana perfume comes pretty close.

After fans spotted rumors of a possible release online, the retailer has officially confirmed that the fragrance is real. Zara has launched an exclusive perfume inspired by Hannah Montana, the beloved Disney Channel character played by Miley Cyrus .

The floral and fruity fragrance captures the attitude and spirit of Hannah Montana with a sweet blend of red fruits, rose and vanilla. The scent begins with a burst of juicy red fruits before transitioning into a luminous rose note and finishing with a soft vanilla sweetness.

For longtime fans of the series, the fragrance also feels like a nod to one of Hannah Montana ’s most memorable storylines. In Season 1, Episode 25, “Smells Like Teen Sellout,” Hannah Montana promotes a raspberry-scented perfume called Eau Wow. However, the pop star quickly realizes she cannot stand the scent after eating five raspberry pies in 10 minutes during a pie-eating contest.

While Eau Wow became a fictional fragrance Hannah Montana would rather forget, Zara’s version offers a sweeter and more wearable take with a balance of fruity and floral notes.

POP CULTURE FAVORITE

Zara

Hannah Montana Disney Perfume 90 ML

$22.90

Buy Now at Zara

A feminine floral and fruity fragrance inspired by the Disney Channel icon.

The Zara Hannah Montana Eau de Toilette features 90 ml (3.04 fl. oz.) of a bright, fruity and floral fragrance. The perfume comes in a statement bottle with a purple cap and Hannah Montana’s signature autograph, while the playful pink packaging features glitter star details inspired by the Disney singer’s style.

The perfume arrives as Hannah Montana nostalgia continues to reach new heights. Zara has already embraced the franchise’s popularity with Hannah Montana-inspired merchandise, including two graphic T-shirts released around the character’s 20th anniversary.

The anniversary celebrations also included the release of the Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special on Disney+ , featuring an exclusive interview with Miley Cyrus hosted by Alex Cooper. The special explored the creation of Hannah Montana, the character’s influence and the lasting impact the series has had on fans worldwide.

FAN FAVORITE FIND

Hannah Montana Disney T-Shirt

$14.36 $35.90 60% off

A regular-fit T-shirt featuring a rhinestone text detail on the front.

Fans looking for a simple Hannah Montana tee can add this style to their wardrobe while it’s on sale. Currently 60% off during Zara’s Sale, the T-shirt is made from a washed-effect cotton blend and comes with rhinestone text detailing on the front showcasing the Disney show’s logo.

DEAL ALERT

Hannah Montana Disney Washed Effect Kids T-Shirt

Buy Now at zara $11.45 $11.45

Young fans can celebrate Hannah Montana with this 50 percent off Zara find.

Made from 100 percent cotton, this kids’ Disney T-shirt comes in sizes for ages six to 14 and features a charcoal washed effect for a vintage-inspired look. The front showcases five black-and-white images of Hannah Montana posing alongside pink and black lettering displaying the singer’s name.

Since premiering in 2006, Hannah Montana has remained one of Disney Channel’s most influential franchises. The show helped launch Cyrus’ career, reshaped kids’ TV and became a major force in music and fashion. The franchise also made an impact on the Billboard charts, with the Hannah Montana: The Movie soundtrack reaching No. 1 on the Billboard 200 in 2009 . The album marked the third soundtrack from the franchise to top the chart, following the success of the first two Hannah Montana TV soundtracks.

Although the series ended in 2011, Hannah Montana’s influence has continued to grow through new generations of fans, anniversary celebrations and nostalgic releases like Zara’s new fragrance .
